title: Comprehensive Functional & Technical Specification: Zantiks-to-Rethomics Analysis App

system_overview.target_users: Behavioral genetics and circadian rhythm researchers using Zantiks MWP systems

key_stages.name: Data Conversion Module
key_stages.description: Converts raw Zantiks CSV output (e.g., circadian_rhythms_glasgow-20250801T141426 (1).csv) into standard Drosophila Activity Monitor (DAM) tab-separated text format (DAM_file.txt).

key_stages.name: Analysis & Visualization Studio
key_stages.description: Links converted DAM files with experimental metadata (e.g., Metadata_150726_ebony.csv) and executes Rethomics analysis pipeline (rethomics_analysis_template.R) for sleep, activity, actograms, and circadian rhythmicity.

header_lines: Row 5: Column Headers: RUNTIME, UNIT, TEMPERATURE, L_OR_D, DAY, HOUR, TIME_BIN, A1..D6

columns.activity_channels: A1 to D6 (24 well activity measurements)

multi_monitor_support.description: Supports batch uploading up to 10 DAM monitor files simultaneously (e.g. Monitor1.txt, Monitor2.txt, ..., Monitor10.txt).

columns.description: Formatted date DD MMM YY (e.g. '01 Aug 25')

required_columns.name: file
required_columns.description: Name of converted DAM text file

visualizations.name: Individual Actograms
visualizations.function: ggetho(dt, aes(z = activity), multiplot = 3) + stat_bar_tile_etho() + facet_wrap(~ region_id)
visualizations.purpose: Multi-period wrapped bar actograms showing individual fly activity counts across 24h/48h/72h periods per period row

visualizations.name: Average Group Actograms
visualizations.function: ggetho(dt, aes(z = activity), multiplot = 3) + stat_bar_tile_etho() + facet_wrap(~ genotype)
visualizations.purpose: Population average multi-period wrapped bar actograms by genotype

visualizations.name: Whole Exp Activity Profile
visualizations.purpose: Continuous activity trajectory across entire experiment
